mechanism: Both drugs have stimulant properties and additive effects on dopaminergic and noradrenergic systems in the CNS, increasing risk of overstimulation, agitation, insomnia, and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for signs of excessive CNS stimulation (tremor, agitation, tachycardia, hypertension) and consider dose reduction or alternative therapy if symptoms develop; baseline and periodic vital sign monitoring recommended.
